about: One table, read by the server's estimate (backend/src/__tests__/nodaro-video-upscale-modes.test.ts) and the editor's (frontend/src/lib/__tests__/nodaro-video-upscale-mode-parity.test.ts): the mode a Nodaro Video Upscale node is estimated in, from its mode, the wired clip (10 s at 30 fps, or none wired) and its tier, and whether the install can run Transparent. Both must decide `expected`.

cases.name: 720p clip at 1080p, no mode, Transparent runs
720p clip at 1080p, no mode, Transparent cannot run
720p clip at 4K, no mode, Transparent cannot run
1080p clip at 1080p (fills the frame), no mode, Transparent runs
160x90 clip at 1080p (more than 4x), no mode, Transparent runs
720p clip at 1080p, explicit Transparent, Transparent cannot run (the run refuses it)
720p clip at 1080p, explicit Sharp, Transparent runs
nothing wired, no mode, Transparent runs
nothing wired, no mode, Transparent cannot run
